items.exampleEn: Today is a special day for me.
items.exampleZh: 今天對我來說是特別的日子。

items.exampleEn: Ice is a form of water.
The school has a big event on Friday.
items.exampleZh: 學校星期五有一個大型活動。

items.exampleEn: What's the matter? You look sad.
items.exampleZh: 怎麼了？你看起來很難過。

items.exampleEn: This book is easy to read.
Can I have a piece of cake?
This is a new type of phone.

items.sentenceEn: This test is easy for me.
items.sentenceZh: 這個考試對我來說很簡單。

items.audioEn: The restaurant is full tonight. Let's go to a different one.
items.audioZh: 這家餐廳今晚客滿了，我們去別家吧。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼要去別家餐廳？

items.sentenceEn: May I have a piece of paper?
This is a special event for our family.
items.sentenceZh: 這是我們家很特別的一件大事。

items.stemEn: What is the ____ with your phone?

items.passageEn: Our town has a special event every spring. It is a food festival. There are many types of food, and you can eat a little of everything. There is also a cake in the form of a big fish! It is easy to join. Just write your name on the list. Every year, the streets are full of people.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上每年春天都有一個特別的活動，是美食節。那裡有很多種食物，每一樣都可以吃一點，還有做成大魚形狀的蛋糕！參加很簡單，只要在名單上寫下名字就好。每年街上都擠滿了人。

questions.questionZh: 這個活動什麼時候舉行？

rubricZh: easy 放在 be 動詞後面（例如 is easy）或名詞前面（例如 an easy question）

items.promptZh: 這家餐廳今晚有一道特別的菜。
referenceEn: This restaurant has a special dish tonight.
Tonight, this restaurant has a special dish.
rubricZh: special 放在名詞前（例如 a special dish）
「特別的菜」可寫，例如 a special dish、a special meal 等
